blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Варгас Жетулиу застрелился более тридцати ___ (лёт, acc. sg.) назад.
exercises.prompt: Getúlio Vargas killed himself with a gun more than thirty years ago.
exercises.why: **лёт → лет** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. лёт · лёта · лёту · лёт · лётом · лёте; pl. лёты · лётов · лётам · лёты · лётами · лётах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Сколько раз в ___ (минута, acc. sg.) в среднем моргает человек?
exercises.prompt: On average, how many times per minute does a person blink?
exercises.why: **минута → минуту** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. минута · минуты · минуте · минуту · минутой · минуте; pl. минуты · минут · минутам · минуты · минутами · минутах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: У меня была внематочная беременность два ___ (год, acc. pl.) назад.
exercises.prompt: I had an ectopic pregnancy two years ago.
exercises.why: **год → года** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural годы; declines like DLI's слова (hard stem): A. слова. Ending — (no ending) → -а.  Declension: sg. год · года · году · год · годом · годе; pl. годы · годов · годам · годы · годами · годах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: В ___ (тот день, acc. pl.) я каждый день играл в теннис с Жанетт.
exercises.prompt: In those days, I played tennis with Jeanette every day.
exercises.why: **день → дни** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural дни; declines like DLI's словари (soft stem): A. словари. Ending -ь → -и, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: дн- + -и.  **тот → те** (acc. pl., agreeing with дни). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новые: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -те → - (the stem changes: те-).  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Судя по степени разложения останков, коня пристрелили где-то ___ (неделя, acc. sg.) назад.
exercises.prompt: Judging by the degree of decay of the remains, the horse was shot about a week ago.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я — declines like DLI's тётя: A. тётю. Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: На ___ (следующее утро, acc. sg.) я опять отправился к Фустову.

Adjective type IV, sibilant (after ж, ч, ш, щ) — declines like DLI's хороший: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ее → -ее. exercises.q: На ___ (другое утро, acc. sg.), чуть забрезжил свет, Джиаффар отправился на базар.
exercises.why: **утро → утро** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о — declines like DLI's окно: A. окно. Ending -о → -о.  **другой → другое** (acc. sg. n., agreeing with утро). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ое → -ое.  Declension: sg. утро · утра · утру · утро · утром · утре; pl. утра · утр · утрам · утра · утрами · утрах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
